# . repeats the last change
text:  ‸a b c d e f
keys:  dw.
want:  ‸c d e f

# a count before . replaces the change's own count
text:  ‸a b c d e f g
keys:  2dw3.
want:  ‸f g

# u undoes an insert session as one step, cursor back where it began
text:  foo ‸bar
keys:  iX<Esc>aYZ<Esc>u
want:  foo X‸bar
